description:
Niagara effects at runtime. Effects are scene nodes (spawn_system) or fire-and-forget bursts (spawn_one_shot).
Workflow: spawn_system (snap_to_ground for effects that sit on the floor) -> get_summary (user variables, emitters) ->
set_user_variable to tune it -> activate / deactivate, or set_system to swap the effect on the same node.
Read the vfx_placement skill before placing effects the user asked for.
name: vfx

tools.description:
Starts an effect, or restarts it from the beginning with reset. Undoable.
Returns: The effect state. Fails if the target has no Niagara component.

target.description: Effect node or actor, e.g. "n12". (Reference to NiagaraComponent: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: vfx.activate

returnValue.description: The effect state. Fails if the target has no Niagara component.
returnValue.title: RuntimeVfxState

tools.description:
Stops spawning new particles; existing ones finish. Undoable.
Returns: The effect state. Fails if the target has no Niagara component.

target.description: Effect node or actor, e.g. "n12". (Reference to NiagaraComponent: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: vfx.deactivate

returnValue.description: The effect state. Fails if the target has no Niagara component.
returnValue.title: RuntimeVfxState

tools.description:
Summary of an effect: system, active and looping flags, user variables with values, and one entry per emitter (enabled, CPU/GPU, renderers). Call it first on an unfamiliar effect.
Returns: The summary; user variables sorted by name, emitters in system order. Fails if the target has no Niagara component.

target.description: Effect node or actor (or actor#Component), e.g. "n12". (Reference to NiagaraComponent: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: vfx.get_summary

returnValue.description: The summary; user variables sorted by name, emitters in system order. Fails if the target has no Niagara component.

user_variables.description: User variables with current values, sorted by name.

type.description: Niagara type: float, int32, bool, Vector, Position, LinearColor, ...

value.description: Current value (number, bool, [x,y,z] or [r,g,b,a]); null for types the tools cannot read. (Any JSON value)

returnValue.title: RuntimeVfxSummary

tools.description:
Reads one user variable.
Returns: The variable with its type and current value. Fails if the variable does not exist (the error lists the available ones).

target.description: Effect node or actor, e.g. "n12". (Reference to NiagaraComponent: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: vfx.get_user_variable

returnValue.description: The variable with its type and current value. Fails if the variable does not exist (the error lists the available ones).

type.description: Niagara type: float, int32, bool, Vector, Position, LinearColor, ...

value.description: Current value (number, bool, [x,y,z] or [r,g,b,a]); null for types the tools cannot read. (Any JSON value)

returnValue.title: RuntimeVfxUserVariable

tools.description:
Lists the user variables of an effect with types and current values (Epic: GetUserVariables).
Returns: User variables sorted by name. Fails if the target has no Niagara component.

target.description: Effect node or actor, e.g. "n12". (Reference to NiagaraComponent: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: vfx.get_user_variables

returnValue.description: User variables sorted by name. Fails if the target has no Niagara component.

type.description: Niagara type: float, int32, bool, Vector, Position, LinearColor, ...

value.description: Current value (number, bool, [x,y,z] or [r,g,b,a]); null for types the tools cannot read. (Any JSON value)

tools.description:
Lists the Niagara effects currently active in the world.
Returns: Total count and the effects (target, system name, location), sorted by target.
tools.name: vfx.list_active

returnValue.description: Total count and the effects (target, system name, location), sorted by target.

total.description: All active effects (the list is cut at `limit`).

returnValue.title: RuntimeVfxActiveList

tools.description:
Swaps the Niagara system of an effect, keeping its place in the scene (Epic: SetSystem). Undoable.
Returns: The effect with its new system. Fails if the target has no Niagara component or the system is not found.

reset_user_variables.description: true: user variables go back to the new system's defaults; false: overrides with matching names are kept.

system.description: The new system, e.g. "/Game/FX/NS_Smoke.NS_Smoke". (Reference to NiagaraSystem: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

target.description: Effect node or actor, e.g. "n12". (Reference to NiagaraComponent: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: vfx.set_system

returnValue.description: The effect with its new system. Fails if the target has no Niagara component or the system is not found.
returnValue.title: RuntimeVfxState

tools.description:
Sets a user variable on an effect: a number (float, int), true/false (bool), [x,y,z] (vector, position) or [r,g,b,a] (color). Undoable.
Returns: The variable after the change and its previous value. Fails if the variable does not exist, or the value does not fit its type (the error names the expected JSON).

target.description: Effect node or actor, e.g. "n12". (Reference to NiagaraComponent: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: vfx.set_user_variable

returnValue.description: The variable after the change and its previous value. Fails if the variable does not exist, or the value does not fit its type (the error names the expected JSON).

previous.description: Value before the change. (Any JSON value)

type.description: Niagara type: float, int32, bool, Vector, Position, LinearColor, ...

value.description: Current value (number, bool, [x,y,z] or [r,g,b,a]); null for types the tools cannot read. (Any JSON value)

returnValue.title: RuntimeVfxVariableChange

tools.description:
Plays a system once at a location and lets it destroy itself when it finishes (explosions, impacts, sparks). Not a scene node and not undoable: it removes itself. Use spawn_system for effects that should stay.
Returns: The system, the final location and whether it loops (a looping system never ends). Fails if the system is not found or a user variable does not exist or fit.

location.description: World position [x, y, z] in cm. ([x, y, z] (cm))

snap_to_ground.description: Move the location down onto the first surface below it.

system.description: Niagara system asset, e.g. "/Game/FX/NS_Explosion.NS_Explosion". (Reference to NiagaraSystem: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

user_variables.description: User variables by name, e.g. {"Size": 2}. (Any JSON value)

tools.name: vfx.spawn_one_shot

returnValue.description: The system, the final location and whether it loops (a looping system never ends). Fails if the system is not found or a user variable does not exist or fit.

looping.description: Whether the system loops forever (a looping system never finishes; prefer spawn_system for it).

returnValue.title: RuntimeVfxOneShot

tools.description:
Spawns a Niagara system as a scene node, optionally setting user variables. Undoable (undo removes it).
Returns: The effect node: id, name, system, location, active flag and its user variable names. Fails if the system is not found, a user variable does not exist or does not fit its type, or the parent is not a node.

location.description: World position [x, y, z] in cm. ([x, y, z] (cm))

parent.description: Optional parent node. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

snap_to_ground.description: Move the location down onto the first surface below it (fires, smoke, puddles).

system.description: Niagara system asset, e.g. "/Niagara/DefaultAssets/DefaultSystem.DefaultSystem". (Reference to NiagaraSystem: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

user_variables.description: User variables by name, e.g. {"SpawnRate": 50, "Color": [1, 0.3, 0, 1]}. (Any JSON value)

tools.name: vfx.spawn_system

returnValue.description: The effect node: id, name, system, location, active flag and its user variable names. Fails if the system is not found, a user variable does not exist or does not fit its type, or the parent is not a node.

snapped_to_ground.description: Whether the location was moved down onto the ground.

user_variables.description: Names of the user variables (set them with set_user_variable).

returnValue.title: RuntimeVfxInfo
